AffineConstructive.tactics.tauto.not_dep.short: Introduces the premises of a goal that is a non-dependent implication or a negation

AffineConstructive.tactics.tauto.axioms.short: Closes a goal that is trivially true, has an empty hypothesis, or is already a hypothesis

AffineConstructive.tactics.tauto.simplif.short: Decomposes hypotheses and goal by the invertible rules of intuitionistic propositional logic, until none applies

d: Local Ltac tauto_intuit flags t_reduce t_solver

AffineConstructive.tactics.tauto.tauto_i.short: The proof search shared by tauto and intuition, with a solver for the goals it leaves

AffineConstructive.tactics.tauto.intuiti.short: Runs the shared search with given recognition flags and solver, after unfolding negation and equivalence

AffineConstructive.tactics.tauto.tauto_i.short: Proves the goal by intuitionistic propositional reasoning alone, or fails with “tauto failed”

AffineConstructive.tactics.tauto.tauto_g.short: The tauto search with given recognition flags; here the intuitionistic search only

AffineConstructive.tactics.tauto.tauto.short: Proves a goal that is an intuitionistic propositional tautology in the base logic, or fails

AffineConstructive.tactics.tauto.intuiti.short: Runs the shared search with the most permissive recognition flags and a given solver
Decomposes the goal by intuitionistic propositional reasoning and calls a solver, by default trivial, on the leaves
